translations.bsb: Or if a man has no one to redeem it for him, but he prospers and acquires enough to redeem his land,
translations.kjv: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem
translations.asv: And if a man have no one to redeem it, and he be waxed rich and find sufficient to redeem it;
